parts.text: Create ONE entirely original premium character design for a happy, thoughtful personal AI teammate. SUBJECT: warm ivory glazed porcelain dormouse with very large rounded ears with glossy forest-green inner bowls, delicate amber nose, dark expressive eyes with visible brow contours, long elegant curled tail with a tiny green tip, slim little body with a rounded belly. Curious happy leaning-forward pose with one paw near its cheek. Fine artisanal porcelain, subtle glaze pooling at curves, beautiful satin highlights, not fluffy. Full body in a balanced front three-quarter view, entire head, limbs, wings and tail fully visible, body occupies about 65 percent of square canvas with generous clean margins. Warm inviting expression and intelligent expressive face, aesthetically beautiful and emotionally engaging, adult-friendly rather than babyish. Each material must look convincingly tactile and meticulously crafted: a premium animated feature character / designer art-toy level of finish. Forest green, warm cream and sage mint with restrained honey/amber or muted apricot accents; harmonious, not dull monochrome. Soft cinematic studio lighting, fine controlled highlights, deep material detail. Plain perfectly uniform light gray backdrop, no floor shadow, no cast shadows, no platform, no scenery, no additional props or objects, no floating particles. NO WORDS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. One character only. Do not imitate any existing branded mascot, no human likeness, no generic helmet robot, no simple ball with eyes. Square character development master.
